title: Embedding release signal orchestration and cost-aware roll-forward
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: New embedding models arrive frequently; naive full-traffic swaps cause unexpected downstream quality regressions, token-cost spikes, and occasional latency regressions for tail tenants. Goal: Define an automated, signal-driven orchestration that stages new embedding variants via shadowing, progressive probability ramp, and cost-aware roll-forward. Success metrics: embedding quality delta (R@10 / MRR) within +/-1% for 95% of tenants, 99th-percentile embedding latency <= existing baseline + 5ms, and no more than 7% increase in token-equivalent cost during ramp windows. Constraints: must integrate with existing edge routing, cohorting, and the observability stack; minimal per-request overhead; support tenant pinning and manual aborts.
proposal_summary: Implement a 4-stage onboarding flow: 1) shadow evaluation (no traffic) with stored-vs-live scoring and drift detection; 2) micro-canary (1% traffic per cohort) with strict SLI gating; 3) adaptive ramp using cost-and-quality signals (auto-pause if cost > X% or quality drop > Y%); 4) full rollout with optional staggered retirement of old variant. Augment telemetry with per-tenant embedding delta histograms, per-batch latency breakdowns, and cost attribution by model variant. Provide a single config surface in the console to set ramp parameters and emergency aborts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Shadow job runs nightly and stores comparison metrics to embeddings-evals (cron job ID recorded). 2) Canary can be started/stopped via console feature flag and exposes canary-id in traces. 3) Automated gating rules detect regressions and automatically pause ramp; alerts created in PagerDuty runbook points to canary artifacts. 4) Documentation and runbooks updated; two internal integrations (Search and Reranker teams) complete smoke signoff.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy tenants may create false positives on quality metrics. Mitigation: require minimum sample size per cohort and median-based aggregations; use OPS sanity checks to exclude anomalous traffic spikes. Risk: cost attribution underestimation for batched requests. Mitigation: capture per-batch size and model variant, and compute amortized token-equivalent cost in telemetry pipeline.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Prep: infra work to tag requests with candidate-variant, add telemetry fields (variant_id, batch_size, kv_cache_hit). Phase 1 - Shadow (7 days): run shadow scorer against production queries, collect deltas and qualitative examples; owners review. Phase 2 - Micro-canary (1-5 days): 1% traffic per cohort with gating; if gates pass, begin Phase 3. Phase 3 - Adaptive ramp (2-14 days): ramp according to cost/quality signals, auto-pause on anomalies. Phase 4 - Full: flip default alias, deprecate old variant on staggered schedule.
rollback_plan: Immediate: console emergency abort toggles to pin old variant for all traffic. Automatic: gating rules trigger a rollback step to 100% old variant if quality delta > threshold or cost overshoot persists for 3 consecutive evaluation windows. Postmortem: capture snapshot of failing cohort, fixed seeds for repro; open incident link in ticket comments.
monitoring_and_alerting: Key metrics: per-cohort R@10 delta, MRR delta, 95/99 latency percentile per variant, KV cache hit rate, per-tenant cost delta. Alerts: P1 alert when quality regression threshold exceeded for >10% of cohorts; P2 alert for cost >7% sustained for 3 windows; P0 for 99th latency regression >10ms. Dashboards: canary-overview, per-tenant delta heatmap, cost-explorer.
tests_and_validation: Automated: unit tests for variant tagging, integration tests for telemetry pipeline, e2e test that simulates micro-canary traffic and validates gating behavior. Manual: review of qualitative failure cases by Search and Relevance PMs; A/B holdout experiments for at least 3 business-critical tenants.
implementation_notes: - Add variant_id header and propagate through routing layer (netty middleware change). - Shadow scorer implemented as a sidecar job writing to embeddings-evals S3 prefix. - Add new telemetry schema fields (variant_id, batch_size, is_shadow) and update parquet ETL. - New console controls: start-canary, abort-canary, set-ramp-parameters. - Gating engine uses rolling 1-hour windows with minimum 500 samples for decision.

2026-03-09: Telemetry schema finalized; data team confirmed retention and cost estimates. Added gating thresholds for first canary run.
